_comment: Captured from `aws sts get-caller-identity --debug` (awscli 2.36.22) with the documented AWS example credentials and no config files. SigV4 is deterministic given credentials, timestamp and request, so this pins our signer against the reference byte-for-byte with no network and no real credentials. Regenerate by rerunning that command and re-extracting the botocore.auth DEBUG blocks.
notes: amz-sdk-invocation-id, amz-sdk-request and user-agent are sent but NOT signed -- SignedHeaders covers only content-type, host, x-amz-date.
The endpoint comes from the ruleset with UseGlobalEndpoint=false, giving the regional sts.us-east-1.amazonaws.com rather than the legacy global sts.amazonaws.com.
